## Security

### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 7.5/10" aria-label="Importance 7.5 of 10">7.5</span> Islamic State Uses Big Tech AI Tools to Develop Explosive Devices
University of Cambridge research, based on interviews with 27 former Boko Haram fighters, found that ISIL affiliates are using AI chatbots from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, and other companies to build bombs, plan attacks, and solve combat problems. Fighters were trained to bypass AI safety controls using encrypted accounts and privacy tools.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>ISWAP and JAS fighters using ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Meta AI, and DeepSeek</li>
<li>ISWAP operatives trained in rooms with laptops and projectors to query AI and bypass safeguards</li>
<li>Accounts with paid subscriptions set up for fighters on multiple AI platforms</li>
<li>Pro-ISIL forum sharing instructions on bypassing AI safety controls</li>
<li>Research based on interviews with 27 former Boko Haram faction members</li>
<li>Aligns with February UN Security Council warning on ISIL using advanced AI</li>
</ul>
